_doc: Dark Knight line (spec #348, ticket D2 #350). A class spec adds jobs/dark_knight.json, skills/dark_knight.json and (later) asset_manifest.d/dark_knight.json, discovered automatically by DataRepo.lines() (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Job 132 is playable since D10 (#358); skill keys stay inert until their skills are defined in skills/dark_knight.json (or the shared line for Power Strike and Slash Blast, which Hero owns). AP and HP growth rows live in this file's balance block.

132._mobility_skill: tier C: spec #348 D1/DK-14: Rush (1321003) is Dark Knight's manual mobility skill on its own key, outside both slot tracks; defined by D8.
132._skill_pool: tier C: spec #348: the eight hand-picked Dark Knight actives (Rush is the mobility skill, not a pool entry). Power Strike and Slash Blast are Hero's definitions (DK-13).
132._weapon_families: tier C: spec #348 DK-10: one-handed and two-handed spears and pole arms (WeaponInfo.family); both are two-handed, so a Dark Knight never wears a shield. Swords, axes and blunt weapons never drop for it; armour and shields drop by the Warrior class bit.
132._creation_weapon: tier C: spec #348 DK-10: the plain Spear (reqJob 13, which includes the Warrior bit, so wearing it needs no class); the level requirement is gone (#292).
132._provenance: tier C: spec #348 D10 #358: Dark Knight is playable alongside the other jobs; 212 remains the default.

hub_kit._fixture: tier C: spec #348 D10: the Dark Knight test character the Free Market kit opens (--hub --job=132).
hub_kit._scrolls: tier C: spec #348 D10: spear (2044300-05) and pole arm (2044400-05) ATT scrolls (100%, 60%, 10% and the two dark scrolls), ids read from scrolls/warrior.json.
hub_kit._equipment: tier C: spec #348 D10: spare hat, a spare pole arm to swap to, gloves and a top, all wearable at Lv1 by a Dark Knight.
hub_kit._fallback_item: tier C: spec #348 D10: the Lv40 Spear the flow driver wears when no round drop is high enough (reqJob Warrior).

132._hp: tier C #350 (orchestrator ruling, spec #348 DK-10): the same melee survivability baseline as Hero (#346), copied from jobs/hero.json balance.player.ap.112.hp; the balance pass owns it.

bot._card_scores: tier C: spec #348 D10 #358 (DK-9): the autoplay bot scores every Dark Knight pool key like an attack (learn card 100, rank card 74); explicit so the Beholder (a summon the default support scoring would undervalue) and the HP-paying Dragon Fury / Dragon Roar are taken. Power Strike and Slash Blast repeat Hero's entries.

132._hp: tier C #350 (orchestrator ruling, spec #348 DK-10): HP growth per level copied from Hero's 112 row (#346); GAME_DESIGN 4.2.
